title: Self-Consistent Recursive Diffusion Bridge for Medical Image Translation
tldr_zh: 配对扩散桥终点改为加噪源图（方差单调递增软先验）+ 每步递归自洽估计 x0，多对比 MRI/MRI→CT 上 PSNR 高 SynDiff 1.2–1.5 dB
tldr_en: Paired diffusion bridge whose end-point is a noised source image (monotone variance, soft prior) plus self-consistent recursive x0 estimation; +1.2-1.5 dB PSNR over SynDiff/DDPM on MRI and MRI-CT.
key_numbers: BRATS T1->T2 PSNR 27.42 vs SynDiff 22.21, DDPM 25.97 (Table II)
Pelvic T2->CT PSNR 28.58 / SSIM 93.28 vs DDPM 26.88 / 91.18, I2SB 26.54 / 85.94 (Table III)
Avg gain over DDMs: +1.25 dB (IXI), +1.49 dB (BRATS), +1.42 dB (MRI-CT) (Sec. V)
Ablation IXI T2->T1: w/o soft prior 30.16, w/o source guidance 20.43, w/o self-consistency 31.28 vs full 31.56 (Table IV)
Hyperparameters: T=1000, gamma=2.2, lambda1=lambda2=1, 50 epochs (Sec. IV-B)
